title: feat(spec): a lookup can declare its target's name visible to every reader of the record (referenceNameVisible)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RUZoTZVTtFoHvJSQucfYQh)_
Fixes #29171

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`lookup`(及 `user`)字段新增可选布尔键 `referenceNameVisible`。设为 true 表示：能读这条记录的人，即使读不到被引用的那条记录，也可以看到它的名称(目标对象 `nameField` 的值)和 id,别的都看不到;展开同样只给名称 + id,界面只显示文字、不带链接。
- 为什么改：执行裁决 6574398310 字母 B。门户用户(如 hotsrm 供应商)读得到自己的记录，但上面指向品类、物料、内部员工的关联只显示「受限记录」;现在由应用按字段声明哪些名称可以给门户看。
- 风险与回滚：只加宽(可选新键，默认关，不写就和今天完全一样);其他字段类型(含 `master_detail`)写这个键会在解析时被拒。本 PR 只是契约，服务端还不返回名称(describe 带 `[PLANNED — not yet served]`)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`(`referenceNameVisible` 声明块与 superRefine 拒收分支)、`packages/spec/src/data/field-reference-name-visible.test.ts`、`.changeset/29171-lookup-reference-name-visible.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-reference-name-visible.test.ts`,预期 1 个文件全绿(19 条)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(合并前席位跑一次契约复审)。

## What changes

`FieldSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) gains one optional boolean, `referenceNameVisible`, beside `referenceVia` / `referenceDeletedWhen`. It carries the ruling's semantics (director ruling 6574398310, letter B):

- `true` declares that a principal who can read the record carrying the field may see the referenced record's display name (the target object's `nameField`, ADR-0079) and its id, even when it cannot read the referenced record. Nothing else of the target: `$expand` on the field returns the same name and id only, the field's own `displayField` does not widen what is shown, and the name renders as text with no link.
- Absent or `false` keeps the restricted-reference posture (objectui#13335). No default materializes at parse.
- Placement is the referencing field only. There is no target-object switch (the ruling refuses one).
- Accepted on `lookup` and on `user`. A `user` field is the `sys_user` reference, which the ruling says the same key covers. Refused at parse on every other type, with one `custom` issue at `referenceNameVisible` naming the legal types and the offending one, in the `mailAssociation` refusal shape. That includes `master_detail` (the ruling places the key on the referencing lookup) and an authored `false` off-type.
- Declared ahead of its producer (ADR-0049): the describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet served]`, which the liveness walker reads as `planned` (`liveness/state-counts/field.md`: planned 5 → 6, classified 110 → 111). The docblock states the read and expand bounds as MUST statements for the server card, and says that no runtime serves the name yet.

Generated files that ride along (`check:generated --fix`, which named 2 of 14 artifacts stale): `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`, `data/object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json` (+1 key), `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`.

Changeset: `.changeset/29171-lookup-reference-name-visible.md`. It bumps spec `minor`, plus `driver-sql` and `metadata-core` `patch` for the census entries below.

### Forced edits (closed key censuses over `FieldSchema`)

A new `FieldSchema` key reds each of these by design. Each was measured red, then given one entry:

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts` `FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS`: `presentation`. The read and expand path reads the key, never `createColumn`. Red was `builtin-column-collision.test.ts` "classifies EVERY FieldSchema key".
- `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts` `FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS`: `keep`. It is a boolean facet that names no field. Red was `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` "classifies every FieldSchema key".
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: the `field` property count goes 81 → 82, with a dated comment line.
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: an `omit` ledger entry, on the `lookupAutofill` / `conditionalFormatting` precedent. The field form does not offer a key nothing serves. The ui card adds the form row together with the renderer.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts` `STRUCTURAL_FIELD_KEYS` gains the key (a permission-class key). This pins that it can never join the ADR-0146 D10 display whitelist, so a customer extension cannot patch a vendor's lookup into exposing names. It was not red; the edit is added coverage.

## Follow-ups (filed by the spec seat once this lands, citing ruling 6574398310)

- **server** (`domain:server`): the objectql/REST read and `$expand` branch. For a field declaring `referenceNameVisible: true` whose target the caller cannot read, it does an elevated name-only read: the target's `nameField` value and id, nothing else, `displayField` ignored. It drops the `[PLANNED — not yet served]` marker and flips the pin in `field-reference-name-visible.test.ts`.
- **ui** (`domain:ui`): the text-only rendering with no link, and the field form row (which removes the reconciliation `omit` entry).
- **hotsrm** (cloud/hotsrm lane): remove the snapshot text fields and sync flows (objectstack-ai/hotsrm#95) once both land.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/data/field-reference-name-visible.test.ts` (new, 19 tests):

- accepts on a lookup, a multi-value lookup, a lookup to `sys_user`, a `user` field, and through `ObjectSchema`;
- an explicit `false` is kept; absent stays absent; a non-boolean value gives `invalid_type`;
- refused on `master_detail`, `tree`, `text`, `select`, `formula` and `number`. Each case checks one `custom` issue at the key and the named subjects, plus a positive control without the key. An off-type `false` is refused too, and the refusal message carries no tracker number;
- the JSON-schema projection is an optional boolean; the description opens with the planned marker, names ADR-0049 and carries the ruling's bounds.

Consumer suites (downstream of spec), at `734d67a6`, each through `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0):

- `@objectstack/spec` test: Test Files 792 passed (792), Tests 23411 passed, 1 todo. typecheck: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql` test: 236 passed, 12 skipped (248); 3847 passed, 214 skipped. typecheck: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core` test: 22 files, 885 tests passed. typecheck: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test: 301 passed, 4 skipped (305); 22127 passed, 26 skipped.
- `@objectstack/lint` test: 189 files, 7830 tests passed.

Before the census edits, at `4c09cb03`, four pins were red as designed. Each named `referenceNameVisible` as unclassified: driver-sql `builtin-column-collision.test.ts`, metadata-core `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts`, metadata-protocol `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (82 against 81), and spec `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`.

No ablation: the parse refusal is new code with its own refusal and control pins, and no existing tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- `user` is accepted beside `lookup`. This reads the ruling's "the same key covers `sys_user` names; no separate carve-out" as covering the dedicated `sys_user` field type, which is stored the same way as a lookup. If the seat reads it as lookup only, the change is a one-line narrowing before landing (open question in the report).
- `master_detail` is refused. The ruling names the referencing lookup. Narrowing first keeps a later widening additive.
- The delta's "beside `referenceFilters`": that key is a retired tombstone on main (16.x line), so the new key sits beside `referenceVia` / `referenceDeletedWhen`.
